context: This criteria evaluates how well an engineer uses the SuperAgent package to implement a resilient HTTP client with retry logic, progress monitoring, and custom validation. The evaluation focuses specifically on proper usage of SuperAgent's advanced API features.

checklist.name: Retry implementation
checklist.description: Uses SuperAgent's .retry() method to configure automatic retry behavior with a count of 2 retries

checklist.name: Custom retry logic
checklist.description: Uses .retry() with a callback function to implement custom retry logic that distinguishes between retryable errors (timeouts, 5xx) and non-retryable errors (4xx)

checklist.name: Progress event handler
checklist.description: Uses .on('progress', callback) to attach progress event listeners that receive progress data including percent, loaded, and direction properties

checklist.name: Custom validation
checklist.description: Uses .ok() method with a callback function to implement custom response validation logic that determines success based on custom criteria

checklist.name: Request execution
checklist.description: Properly executes SuperAgent requests using .end(), .then(), or async/await patterns to handle responses and errors
